findings.summary: The new vendor Northbeam Analytic Inc. appears to duplicate an existing vendor Northbeam Analytics based on email domain and address similarity, but has different bank account details.

findings.title: Name/email domain/address duplicate vendor
findings.detail: The new vendor shares the same email domain and a very similar address with an existing vendor, indicating a duplicate.

findings.title: Name/email domain/address duplicate vendor
findings.detail: The existing vendor record shows the same email domain and a matching address, confirming duplication.

findings.title: Bank account mismatch for duplicate vendor
findings.detail: Although the vendor appears duplicated, the bank account information differs between the new and existing records.

findings.title: Bank account mismatch for duplicate vendor
findings.detail: The existing vendor lists a different bank account, indicating a discrepancy that requires verification.

findings.title: Duplicate vendor policy not found
findings.detail: The duplicate vendor policy was not found in the retrieved passages, so it could not be quoted.
